title: Mulahbae confronts love’s darkest crossroads in “HATE TO HATE ME”
htmlContent:
Mulahbae’s new single, “HATE TO HATE ME,” takes you through the ups and downs of a complicated relationship. This powerful pop song is filled with emotion, making it feel like a deep cleansing of feelings. “HATE TO HATE ME” pulls you into a mix of frustration, closeness, and acceptance. Mulahbae shares their feelings openly, capturing the push and pull of a complicated romance.

The music is smooth yet bold, combining dark sounds with a beat that mirrors the tensions in the lyrics. It strikes a balance between heartbreak and standing strong, perfectly showcasing the complexity of loving someone you wish to forget. Mulahbae skillfully combines vulnerability and strength, using pain as motivation rather than letting it hold them back. The vocals cut through the emotions with a powerful delivery that feels hurt and strong.

https://open.spotify.com/album/3qKonnTVvd5yzvAx4OU9sR?si=CeR4VDr1RZSuv3YoQ4XSqQ

“HATE TO HATE ME” is all about getting your power back. It’s the kind of song you’ll want to sing at the top of your lungs, allowing all your feelings to emerge. Mulahbae helps you experience every emotional high and low along the way. With this deeply personal yet relatable single, Mulahbae shows that music can be a source of healing for everyone.
